instruction: Query arXiv for October 11, 2023 publications on new foundational language models and add at least 3 complete entries to the table with paper names, arXiv PDF links, and publication dates.

parameters.window_name: New Large Language Models.xlsx - LibreOffice Calc

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding at least 3 LLM papers from arXiv on Oct 11, 2023 and ensuring all three columns (title, link, date) are complete. Evaluator checks that all three columns A, B, and C each have at least 3 non-empty entries. The getter counts non-empty cells per column, and the metric verifies all required columns meet the minimum threshold, ensuring complete data entry.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly implements completeness check: verifies all 3 required columns (A, B, C) each have at least 3 non-empty entries
Proper handling of type='rule' parameter pattern: metric function correctly accesses expected dict with expected.get('min_rows_per_column') and expected.get('required_columns')
Postconfig correctly saves the file (Ctrl+S) before verification, ensuring getter reads current state
Partial credit scoring is reasonable: returns ratio of passing columns to required columns
Limitation: only verifies quantity (at least 3 entries), not content quality (whether entries are actual arXiv papers from Oct 11, 2023 with valid PDF links)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: To improve content verification, could add checks for: arXiv URL pattern validation, date field format verification, or text pattern matching for paper titles
Static warning about dict vs Dict type annotation is minor and doesn't affect runtime behavior
